name: Zetharis
title: Hexblade Warlock
role: The party's Eldritch Blast turret: Charisma added to every beam twice in the Potent Robe, with a shield and the Shield spell to stay standing.

+1 CHA for 18, and double proficiency on Deception and Performance

Mage Armour at will, for AC in the robe

gear.note: Scorching Ray once a day.
Extra movement for 3 turns at the start of combat.
Medium armour: crits can't land on you. For before you have the robe.
+1 to spell attack rolls, which every beam uses.
+1 to attack rolls, spells included.
While concentrating on Hex, you can't be knocked Prone or moved.
Bonus-action Misty Step each short rest; immune to webs, grease and ice.
Restore a spell slot up to 3rd level once a day: big for a Warlock's two slots.
Bonus-action Misty Step each short rest.
+1 AC and saves.
Spell and cantrip damage gives Lightning Charges, every beam included.
Adds your CHA to cantrip damage, so each beam gets it twice with Agonising Blast; temporary HP every turn.
Medium armour that adds full DEX, for before you have the robe.
Crit range −1 while you're obscured: blast from inside your Darkness.
+1 AC and saves.
Ranged spell attacks add Reverberation, so every beam stacks it.
Restore one spell slot of any level once a day.
+2 radiant damage per beam against lit targets.
Spell damage while you're lit adds Radiating Orb, which also lights the target for Callous Glow.
Advantage on attack rolls, Disadvantage on saves.
After a kill, your next attack is a crit, once a day.
+1 to ranged spell attacks, plus Fireball once a day.
An extra 1st-level spell slot and a self-Aid.
+2 CHA (up to 22): +2 on every beam, twice over in the robe.
+2 to spell attack rolls and save DC.
Crit range −1.
Rerolls 1s and 2s on spell attack damage dice.
Attacks against you have Disadvantage until you take damage.
Once per short rest, a cantrip costs a bonus action: a second Eldritch Blast that turn.
−5 to hit for +1d8 damage on spell attacks, toggled.
+1d6 force on every crit.
+1 to spell attack rolls and save DC.
Can't be pushed, and can turn a failed save into a success.
Advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves.
+1 spell attack and save DC, and one free spell a day.
+1 spell attack and save DC, and one free spell a day.
Cast Shield once a day without a slot.
+3 AC, and enemy spell attacks have Disadvantage.

loadouts.label: Act 1
loadouts.intro: Medium armour and a shield until the robe; one beam until level 5.

loadouts.label: Act 2
loadouts.intro: The Potent Robe arrives: each beam adds your CHA twice from here on.

loadouts.label: Act 3
loadouts.intro: Three beams from level 10: stack Charisma, crit range or a second blast a turn.
